items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The first thing I should have done is try to get him to engage a registered practitioner who knew how to do the work properly.

ctx.x: The first thing I should have done is try to get him to engage a registered practitioner who knew how to do the work properly. And see, I was not experienced enough to know how to do ... I did what little work I knew how, but I wasn't able enough to know the truth.
But I had been going longer than you, and I should have asked you to go with me.
